title: John Sees the Living One
reflectionText: John heard a trumpet-like voice, turned among seven golden lamp stands, and fell like a dead man before the Living one. A right hand touched him with the words, “Do not be afraid.” What is it to receive that command from the one holding Death’s keys?
editorialNotes: Packet 014 writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling keeps WEB assembly, Kingdom, lamp stand, and Death/Hades wording distinct from KJV church, kings and priests, candlestick, and hell/death wording, and explains only the symbols identified in Revelation 1:20.
